_comment: Synthetic fixture for make_units.py census-grade (VERIFICATION-PROGRAM.md 2.2). One run = one scenario. Rows are per hooked function: {addr, scenario, frames, calls, frames_with_calls, calls_per_frame_hist {calls-in-a-frame: frame-count}, callers {return-site function addr: count}, first_frame, last_frame, classification}. `events` are the telemetry event counts of the same run (events.csv); when absent make_units reads <run>/events.csv. Addresses below are physics functions that have cadence-claim units; the numbers are invented. A bare JSON list of rows is also accepted (scenario taken from the run directory name).
